lua: PREVIEW.order=table.concat(settings.display.order,','); PREVIEW.count_dividers=function(value) local count=0; for _,run in ipairs(PREVIEW_PY.hud_runs()) do if run.text==value then count=count+1 end end; return count end

assert(settings.display.divider==' | ','Add all did not choose visible pipes'); for _,item in ipairs(require('ui.defaults').READOUTS) do assert(settings.display.dividers[item.id],'Add all skipped a readout') end; PREVIEW.pipe_count=PREVIEW.count_dividers(' | '); assert(PREVIEW.pipe_count>=4,'Visible pipes were not drawn')
assert(settings.display.dividers.progress==false,'Row checkbox did not remove divider'); assert(PREVIEW.count_dividers(' | ')==PREVIEW.pipe_count-1,'Removed divider was still drawn')
assert(settings.display.dividers.progress==true,'Row checkbox did not restore divider'); assert(PREVIEW.count_dividers(' | ')==PREVIEW.pipe_count,'Restored divider was not drawn')
assert(settings.display.divider==' / ','Style selector did not choose Slash'); assert(PREVIEW.count_dividers(' / ')==PREVIEW.pipe_count,'Slash dividers were not drawn')

for _,item in ipairs(require('ui.defaults').READOUTS) do assert(settings.display.dividers[item.id]==false,'Remove all skipped a readout') end; assert(settings.display.divider==' / ','Remove all changed the saved style'); assert(PREVIEW.count_dividers(' / ')==0,'Remove all left visible dividers'); settings.window.sections['Display/Dividers and formatting']=true; PREVIEW.edit_custom=true
assert(settings.display.divider:find('~',1,true),'Custom divider input was not editable'); PREVIEW.custom_divider=settings.display.divider; PREVIEW.edit_custom=false

assert(settings.display.divider==PREVIEW.custom_divider,'Add all replaced custom text'); assert(PREVIEW.count_dividers(PREVIEW.custom_divider)==PREVIEW.pipe_count,'Custom dividers were not drawn'); assert(table.concat(settings.display.order,',')==PREVIEW.order,'Divider edits changed readout order')
